en-US.longDescription: The GitHub MCP Server connects AI tools directly to GitHub's platform. This gives AI agents, assistants, and chatbots the ability to read repositories and code files, manage issues and PRs, analyze code, and automate workflows. All through natural language interactions.
en-US.name: GitHub MCP Server
en-US.releaseNotes:
What's Changed
- build(deps): bump @modelcontextprotocol/client from 2.2.0 to 2.3.1 in /ui by @dependabot[bot] in #3462
- build(deps-dev): bump @vitejs/plugin-react from 6.1.1 to 6.1.2 in /ui by @dependabot[bot] in #3461
- Fix UTF-8 encoding in repository resource URIs by @lorenzozanee in #3437
- fix(repos): return a resource link for files over 1 MB in get_file_contents by @jayhemnani9910 in #3419
- Add cursor pagination to list_label by @A-Georgiou in #3505
- upgrade to Go 1.27.3 for compromised CA mitigation by @marcherschel in #3540
Full Changelog: v2.0.2...v2.0.3
